title: .NET 10 Breaking Changes
description: Understand the breaking changes in .NET 10 and ASP.NET Core 10, and learn how to migrate your existing applications.
longDescription: This module covers the important breaking changes introduced in .NET 10. You will learn about cookie login redirects being disabled for known API endpoints, the deprecation of MVC API analyzers in favor of TypedResults, the obsolescence of Razor runtime compilation, and changes to PipeReader-based JSON parsing behavior.
whatYouLearn: Understand cookie login redirect changes for API endpoints
Migrate from MVC API analyzers to TypedResults
Replace Razor runtime compilation with alternative approaches
Adapt to PipeReader-based JSON parsing changes
